topic: Editable scene compilation and transactional keyframes
topic_zh: 可编辑场景编译与原子关键帧
scope: Local scene validation, exact keyframe querying and Node CPU lookup. No Autograph MCP execution, model inference, physical motion certification or display latency measured.

checks.name: lookup-equivalence-64
checks.detail: 64 keys per track yield identical linear and binary results

checks.name: lookup-equivalence-256
checks.detail: 256 keys per track yield identical linear and binary results

checks.name: lookup-equivalence-2048
checks.detail: 2048 keys per track yield identical linear and binary results

checks.name: local-track-edit
checks.detail: editing A key at 4s changes A while B and C remain identical

checks.name: atomic-rejection
checks.detail: invalid duplicate-time edit leaves the last valid scene unchanged

checks.name: seek-reversal
checks.detail: 7 timestamps retain exact transforms under reverse visitation

checks.name: roundtrip-scene
checks.detail: exported scene recompiles without losing track meaning

checks.name: mobile-layout
checks.detail: 390px motion and JSON controls fit without horizontal overflow

checks.name: reduced-motion
checks.detail: reduced-motion scene is still until explicit playback

timing_note: Median of 7 Node CPU runs; each run performs 3000 scene queries. Both lookup algorithms produce identical positions. Rendering, model calls and display latency are excluded.

protocol.function: editable source → complete validation → atomic scene commit → timestamp query → SVG transforms
